title: Semaglutide vs Retatrutide
summary: Semaglutide: tier approved label, 6,039 indexed publications, 305 randomized trials. Retatrutide: tier human clinical trial, 197 indexed publications, 7 randomized trials. 8 indexed studies compare them directly; the head-to-head section quotes what they state.

seo.title: Semaglutide vs Retatrutide: what the studies show
seo.description: Semaglutide vs Retatrutide, side by side from each compound's own cited record, plus any direct head-to-head trial. Not advice.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2026: Given the therapeutic potential of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide) in diabetic nephropathy, we evaluated their anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory effects in non-diabetic renal fibrosis using HK-2 cells and murine UUO and aging models.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2026: Recently, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs, including semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide, have been explored as potential anti-obesity therapies.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Recently, glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs, including semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide, have been explored as potential anti-obesity therapies.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, rats, 2026: GLP-1 receptor agonists, including semaglutide, reduce alcohol intake and relapse-like behaviors in rodent and non-human primate models, and a recent clinical trial found that semaglutide decreased alcohol craving and drinking in adults with AUD.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2025: We report that in pre-clinical models with significant retatrutide (RETA, LY3437943)-induced weight loss, pancreatic cancer engraftment was reduced, tumor onset was delayed, and progression was attenuated resulting in a 14-fold reduction in tumor volume compared to only 4-fold reduction in single agonist…
head_to_head.source_excerpt: We report that in pre-clinical models with significant retatrutide (RETA, LY3437943)-induced weight loss, pancreatic cancer engraftment was reduced, tumor onset was delayed, and progression was attenuated resulting in a 14-fold reduction in tumor volume compared to only 4-fold reduction in single agonist semaglutide-treated mice.

head_to_head.value: Clinical trial, humans, n=214, 2026: Compared with placebo, weight loss was greatest with retatrutide (-22.10%, 95% confidence interval -25.60% to -18.60%), followed by tirzepatide (-19.28%, -20.39% to -18.16%), and CagriSema (a combination of cagrilintide and semaglutide, -17.32%, -19.32% to -15.32%).
head_to_head.source_excerpt: Compared with placebo, weight loss was greatest with retatrutide (-22.10%, 95% confidence interval -25.60% to -18.60%), followed by tirzepatide (-19.28%, -20.39% to -18.16%), and CagriSema (a combination of cagrilintide and semaglutide, -17.32%, -19.32% to -15.32%).

head_to_head.value: In vitro study, humans, 2023: Although retatrutide may be superior to the GLP-1 receptor agonist dulaglutide in reducing plasma glucose and body weight, this is not a meaningful comparison, as another GLP-1 receptor agonist (semaglutide) is more potent than dulaglutide at this and may have similar efficacy to retatrutide.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, 2026: Recent evidence reinforces this framework: the SOUL trial established cardiovascular superiority for oral semaglutide, extending disease-modifying properties beyond injectable formulations, while Phase 3 TRIUMPH data position retatrutide as an emerging triple-agonist candidate awaiting cardiovascular outcome data.

head_to_head.value: In vitro study, humans, 2026: In patients with type 2 diabetes, semaglutide prevents chronic kidney disease (CKD), while retatrutide reduces albuminuria in patients with diabetes and established CKD.
